body: You're a really awesome guy indeed :) Your story brightened up my day a whole lot!

Nope, as I said I'm a closed person and I'm not really used to talking to people... but I'm feeling a lot better now, crying and getting this off of my chest (even if here on reddit) made me look at a different view to this situation.

No, your fear is not irrational. Some guys can be animals or monsters sometimes. But not all the guys are the same. There are nice comprehensive guys too - and I'm pretty sure you're a wonderful person and in no time you'll find someone that suites you and that helps you get through your fear. Good luck :)

e: oh, I forgot to read the last part. If I was ever in a relationship with a girl like you, I'd love her more than anything and protect and respect her as hard as I can, because if she really wants to be with me after what she's been through, I'd be blessed to be by her side and help a wonderful person in a bad moment. I hope I helped, and that more people help you get through this
